claim_boundary: fixed-weight, base-fit-only global geometry covariates; no geometry mechanism, channel relation, routing, adaptation, learning, or causal claim
target_rule: Each condition applies its listed permutation jointly to symbols and reliabilities; paired histories retain the full evidence-pair multiset and public log-odds target within 1e-12.
fitting_rule: Fit every projection, mean/scale, tracker, and subspace basis only on base-order train32 cue6-to-delay8 states. Apply unchanged objects to paired eval32 clouds.
aggregation: Within seed, median descriptor differences across fixed projections; all cells remain dependent descriptions.
control: Identity is calibration only. Retain true R2/latest/shuffle only to verify final-slot matching.
decision_rule: Report a descriptor only as a descriptive covariate if base-minus-upstream has one nonzero direction in at least three of four seeds. Do not infer explanation or nominate channels.
